project_task: Create an insurance claim intake and triage workflow.
project_goal: Collect complete loss reports and route them for review.
project_description: A policyholder reports a loss, uploads evidence, and receives a case number; an adjuster triages it.
functional_requirements: A policyholder identifies an active policy.
The policyholder reports loss date, location, and description.
The system creates a claim number for a complete report.
An adjuster assigns a severity and review route.
non_functional_requirements: Sensitive claim data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
